echoParts: of the Father and of the Son
verseText: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit…
meaning: This is the Great Commission: the mission Jesus gave to his followers. Our job is to be disciples who go and make new disciples all over the world.
